mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AS day UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(day, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM dates WHERE day < #{endDate} ) SELECT a.id, COALESCE(a.enterprise_id, 1) AS enterprise_id, u.id AS user_id, dates.day AS attendance_date, a.clock_in_time, a.clock_out_time, COALESCE(a.work_start_time, r.work_start_time) AS work_start_time, COALESCE(a.work_end_time, r.work_end_time) AS work_end_time, COALESCE(a.is_rest_day, CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(dates.day) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_rest_day, COALESCE(a.is_late, 0) AS is_late, COALESCE(a.is_early, 0) AS is_early FROM dates CROSS JOIN sys_user u LEFT JOIN employee_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN attendance_record a ON a.user_id = u.id AND a.attendance_date = dates.day INNER JOIN attendance_rule r ON r.id = 1 WHERE (a.id IS NOT NULL OR (u.audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND u.user_status = 'ENABLED' AND p.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND dates.day >= DATE(COALESCE(u.reviewed_at, u.create_time)) AND (p.hire_date IS NULL OR dates.day >= p.hire_date))) AND u.id = #{userId} AND (LOCATE(#{keyword}, u.user_name) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, u.real_name) > 0) AND u.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY dates.day DESC, u.id DESC
mapper.sql: a.id, a.enterprise_id, a.user_id, a.attendance_date, a.clock_in_time, a.clock_out_time, a.work_start_time, a.work_end_time, a.is_rest_day, a.is_late, a.is_early
mapper.select: SELECT FROM attendance_record a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.attendance_date = #{date}
